title: argemone platyceras var. gracilenta
intro: Argemone platyceras var. gracilenta, commonly known as Mexican prickly poppy, is a plant species in the Papaveraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and analgesic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Mexican prickly poppy include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
